notes.notes:
Bonjour folks!

Another little patch-lette.  Details below :

Version 0.205 - June 2nd

 Improved visuals on interactables (lamps over buttons)
 Further improvements to the pause menu controls layout

notes.title: Patch notes 0.204
notes.notes:
Honk honk!

A little patch to help with the keyboard controls :

- Version 0.204

Revamped binding menu - now you can filter bindings by type, and you have to apply changes rather than having them occur immediately
Added menu function controls to the pause screen controls
Reorganized menu bindings - pause is on Escape, codex is now on Return and back is on Backspace
Improved ‘left shift’ and ‘right shift’ icons
Made it so that the cat is always cat1 when fused in single player (meaning input prompts are more appropriate)
Fixed a few graphical issues
Tweaked a few puzzle elements to be more friendly to players


Still more work to do on the inputs front, but hopefully this makes things a bit easier for now!

notes.title: Demo patched - version 0.202
notes.notes:
Ahoyhoy!

The demo only just went live, but we have a day one patch!  It's almost like we're a triple-A title or something!

This is just a few nips and tucks that we were able to put in the game.  Details for changes in the demo, and also in this new patch, are below.

One note - in case you are having trouble getting the demo working on Steam Deck, please try changing the compatibility settings and using Proton 9.0.

Change list :

- Version 0.201 (new demo)
    - New demo content - Split Labs Alpha
    - Fixed bug with jumping system occasionally hanging
    - Increased stability after level load
    - New dynamic help panels
    - Added smoothing to character movement
    - Fixed cat’s ears not staying down under hats (does not apply to cutscenes)
    - New emote/costume system
    - Pause menu controller diagram added
    - Improved visual settings, allowing monitor-switching and windowed mode
    - Improved hud settings, allowing overscan image

- Version 0.202 (first patch) - 30th may
    - Tweaks to level layouts
    - Tweaks to glass materials used
    - Tweaks to some icon sizes on in world screens
    - Added keyboard inputs to the game controller diagram in the pause menu
    - Version number visible at all times

notes.title: Demo patched - version 0.1.06
notes.notes:
Ahoyhoy folks!

We just updated the demo to fix a few bugs.  Hopefully the issues people have been seeing in the second level (robots not responding to items and puddles, Mittens pinging around when interacting with items) are solved now.

Patch notes follow!

- April 09 (version 0.1.06)
- Fixed panel clipping mask bug in non 16x9 aspect ratios
- Improved Codex with chat history and synopsis
- Further improved jumping
- Allow swapping cats based on Y/Triangle button press
- Skip tapping gameplay option added to accessibility menu
- Fixed bug with transit tubes (which may also have fixed another bug where Mittens pings around weirdly when picking up items)

notes.title: Demo patched - version 0.0.06
notes.notes:
Ahoyhoy folks!

It took a while to get it working, but we now have Co-op with one player on Keyboard and the other on Controller working!

In the Control Settings is a new option - "Use Keyboard as Co-Op Player 2" - turning this on will allow one player to use keyboard controls with the other using a game controller.

Also, information was added to the Codex note on Co-operative Controls detailing how to get Remote Play Together working with Keyboard Co-op.

The trick is to flush the controllers (from the settings menu) and then add the controllers again once Remote Play is active.  In Keyboard Co-op mode, the host player will have to use the keyboard.

Patch notes follow!

- Feb 14 (version 0.0.06)
    - Controller and keyboard co-op support added
    - Improved pop up help to include alternate message for co-op mode
    - Allowed co-op mode to be started before the cat gains her powers
    - Added information to the Co-operative Controls codex entry detailing how to use Keyboard Co-op and Remote Play Together.
    - Accidentally put the wrong version number and date in the build, so this patch is now from the future
